intro: This document provides a comprehensive land cover and land use nomenclature guideline for the Copernicus local land monitoring product focusing on Coastal Zones. It details a multi-level hierarchical classification system for all land features within coastal environments, cross-referencing to MAES Level 2 ecosystem types. The guideline offers structured definitions, geographic characteristics, and interpretation methods for ensuring accurate and consistent classification, standardising the process for the 2012-2018 product series.
